description: Shared utility functions and constants for managing and displaying cron jobs in a CLI environment, including parsing durations, formatting schedules, and printing cron job lists.

methods.name: getCronChannelOptions
methods.description: Generates options string for cron channel selection, including plugin IDs.

methods.name: printCronJson
methods.description: Outputs a value as JSON via the runtime.

methods.name: handleCronCliError
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits the process with code 1.

methods.name: warnIfCronSchedulerDisabled
methods.description: Checks cron scheduler status via gateway and warns if disabled.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses a duration string (e.g., '30s', '1m') into milliseconds.

methods.name: parseCronStaggerMs
methods.description: Parses stagger parameters into milliseconds, considering 'useExact' flag.

methods.name: parseAt
methods.description: Parses a datetime string or duration into an ISO UTC string, considering timezone if provided.

methods.name: printCronList
methods.description: Prints a formatted list of cron jobs with status and schedule details.
